additions.provenance: server_only one-time bootstrap first validates the current shared Manager operational session, derives its hotel_id, resolves the selected active staff_user inside that hotel and requires role hotel_manager; this query checks only whether any active development credential already exists for that exact hotel and closes bootstrap permanently once one exists

server_only one-time bootstrap inserts only the validated same-hotel hotel_manager staff_user credential after confirming zero existing active credentials; only a salted scrypt PIN hash is persisted and the composite hotel_id+staff_user_id FK prevents cross-hotel identity
server_only learner or manager helper reads training plans only by development-identity-derived hotel_id plus an explicit id set previously derived from same-hotel assignments or standards

server_only learner helper reads assessments only by development-identity hotel_id and training_plan_revision_id values derived from that learner own assignments; assessment JSON is passed through learner materialization before response so correct answer keys are removed
server_only learner state reads only assignments matching development-session-derived hotel_id plus exact staff_user_id
server_only learner state reads only completions matching development-session-derived hotel_id plus exact staff_user_id
server_only learner state reads only assessment attempts matching development-session-derived hotel_id plus exact staff_user_id
server_only learner state reads only immutable verified results matching development-session-derived hotel_id plus exact staff_user_id

server_only manager overview first requires individual department_manager or hotel_manager development identity, reads only active staff_users for that identity hotel_id and then restricts department_manager results to the manager own department

server_only manager standards overview is scoped by development-identity hotel_id; department_manager output is further filtered to standards whose departmentCodes include the current operational department while hotel_manager may view the hotel
server_only manager overview reads plans only for development-identity hotel_id and standard revision ids already filtered to the manager hotel or department scope
server_only manager overview reads assignments by development-identity hotel_id and intersects both allowed staff_user_ids and allowed training_plan_revision_ids
server_only manager review queue reads only pending_human_review attempts inside the identity hotel and intersects allowed staff_user_ids plus allowed assignment ids from the same scoped overview

server_only manager review queue loads assessment definitions only by identity hotel_id and assessment ids referenced by already scoped pending attempts; raw answer authority is exposed only to identified managers for review
server_only manager results overview reads immutable verified results by identity hotel_id and the already department-scoped or hotel-scoped staff id set

server_only manager HR evaluation overview reads advisory evaluations by identity hotel_id and the already scoped staff id set; evaluations themselves enforce human_manager decision authority and no automated employment decision

server_only HR rule definitions are read only when the individual development identity role is hotel_manager and remain scoped by that manager hotel_id; department_manager receives no hotel-level HR rule definitions
